title: Durchsuchungsbeschlüsse wegen des Verdachts des bandenmäßigen Drogenhandels vollstreckt – vierzehn Festnahmen

extraction.summaryEn: Police and prosecutors executed 28 search warrants in Berlin and Brandenburg against a suspected gang dealing drugs from bunker apartments. Fourteen suspects were provisionally arrested, and drugs, cash, knives and a blank-firing gun were seized.
